_meta.domain_name: Baseball Game and Statistical Data Management
_meta.definition: The process of managing game details, player statistics, fielding statistics, and team analysis for baseball games.

columns.name: yearkey
columns.description: Stores unique year identifier for home games.

columns.name: leaguekey
columns.description: Stored are initials of baseball leagues for home games (e.g., NA denotes no league specified).

columns.name: teamkey
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for home team in baseball games (e.g., BS1, CH1, CL1).

columns.name: parkkey
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for baseball parks where home games are played.

columns.name: spanfirst
columns.description: Stores dates of the first home games played in each season.

columns.name: spanlast
columns.description: Stores dates of home games played in the 1871 baseball season.

columns.name: games
columns.description: Stores count of home games played by each team in a season.

columns.name: openings
columns.description: Stores the order of home team's first at-bat innings in games.

columns.name: attendance
columns.description: Stores the number of spectators attending home baseball games.
